name: Petrichor
positioning: For Texas water districts and ranchers, Petrichor is the rain enhancement laboratory that measures every mission and publishes the data.

brand.note: Five colours. Everything else in the system is derived from ground and ink.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.job: The page. Also the text that sits on a filled primary, accent or secondary block.
tokens.rationale: Black gives telemetry and map fills the full contrast range. Paper is caliche, the ground rain falls on.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.job: All primary text and numerals.
tokens.rationale: A cool white reads as instrument glass. Pure white glares on black.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.job: The one most important fill on a page. Sampled from the seeded-cell polygons in the console.
tokens.rationale: An earthy green carries wet ground. A saturated green carries software.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.job: Links, the mark's band, and the one value a decision turns on. The only green set as text.
tokens.rationale: Primary is too dark to read as text on black. Accent is the same hue lifted until it clears 4.5:1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.job: Section labels, record numbers, print covers.
tokens.rationale: Dry grass. Petrichor is rain meeting dry earth, so the earth belongs in the palette.

derived.note: Mixed from ink into ground with color-mix(in srgb). Ratios differ per theme so each step clears its contrast floor on both grounds.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.job: Cards and panels sitting on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.job: Hovered rows and the active item in a list.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.job: Rules between rows. Decorative. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.job: Control borders. Clears 3:1 on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.job: Units, timestamps, disabled text. Clears 4.5:1 on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.job: Field labels and secondary copy. Clears 5.5:1 on surface-raised.

type.note: Two families. Both SIL Open Font License 1.1, served from Google Fonts.

sans.job: Display and interface. Carries the wordmark.
sans.rationale: A grotesque drawn for signage and documents. It holds up in uppercase at 0.1em tracking, which is how the wordmark is set.

mono.job: Every number a person acts on. Coordinates, altitudes, record numbers.
mono.rationale: Tabular figures line up a column of altitudes. A reading a pilot acts on should look like a reading.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: We fly the clouds that make rain.
styles.job: The one statement at the top of a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Petrichor operates from Austin under a Texas weather modification licence.

styles.name: data-l
styles.job: The single number a screen exists to show.

styles.name: data
styles.job: Every value in a readout row.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.job: Gap between a value and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.job: Chip padding-block; gap between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.job: Chip padding-inline; button padding-block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.job: The base step. Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.job: Gap between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.job: Gap between panels. The sounding pitch in the mark.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.job: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.job: Space between page sections.

radius.note: Square by default. The system is an instrument.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.job: Panels, cards, tables, map frames.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.job: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-selector
tokens.job: Status pills only. A pill always means a state.

donts: Do not set primary as text. Use accent.
Do not add a sixth colour. Status belongs in a word, not a hue.
Do not round a panel. Only status pills take a radius.
